secrets.unavailableTitle: API keys cannot be stored securely on this system
secrets.unavailableBody: No OS keyring was found (on Linux, install and unlock GNOME Keyring or KWallet, then restart Comitiva). Connections that need no key, such as Ollama or LM Studio, still work.

connections.title: Connections
connections.subtitle: Ways to reach a language model. Keys stay in your OS keychain.
connections.emptyBody: Add Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini, Ollama or LM Studio, or use Claude Code or Codex with your own login.
connections.deleteBody: Its stored API key, if any, is removed too. This cannot be undone.

form.name: Name
form.keySavedPlaceholder: A key is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
form.keyRequired: This provider needs an API key.
form.baseUrlAdvancedHint: Leave blank to use the provider's endpoint.
form.baseUrlInvalid: Enter a full URL, like https://example.com/v1.

cli.autoAcceptTitle: Runs on its own, without asking
cli.autoAcceptBody: {{harness}} runs non-interactively and accepts every action it decides to take (editing files, running commands) inside the working directory, without asking you first. Use a working directory you are comfortable letting it change.
cli.nativeToolsWarning: {{harness}}'s own file edits cannot be routed through Comitiva's approvals: they happen directly, limited only by its sandbox.
cli.messageStreaming: Replies arrive one message at a time, not word by word.
cli.binaryHint: Leave blank to find it on PATH and in the usual install locations.
cli.workingDirectoryHint: Leave blank to give each conversation its own folder in Comitiva's data folder.

sandboxHelp.workspace-write: Codex can read anywhere and write only inside the working directory, enforced by the OS.
sandboxHelp.read-only: Codex can read but not change files or run commands that write.
sandboxHelp.danger-full-access: No OS sandbox: Codex can change anything your user account can. Use it only when the sandbox cannot start on this system.

cli.extraArgsHint: One argument per line, added after Comitiva's own flags (they can override them).
cli.loginHint: Run `{{command}}` in a terminal, then test again.
cli.sandboxHint: Switch the sandbox to Full access, or fix the sandbox on this system.
cli.testSlow: The test sends a short prompt; a CLI can take a while to start.
